headline: Nettle Constructions files SEBI Reg. 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition in RattanIndia Enterprises
sum: Nettle Constructions Private Limited has filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition or change in shareholding in NSE-listed RattanIndia Enterprises Limited.
detail: Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure within 4 working days of crossing critical thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, etc.) in a listed company. The filing by Nettle Constructions indicates it has crossed at least one such threshold in RattanIndia Enterprises. Depending on the % disclosed, this may mandate an open offer to other shareholders under SEBI Takeover Regulations. The form captures the acquirer's intent, financing source, and board composition post-acquisition, creating a public record binding the acquirer.
